content:
Priya (People Ops): Hey all 1 planning to start 12-week parental leave on Mon Oct 2. Also will be changing visa/status the week before. Two asks: 1) what exact docs/payroll deadlines so Redwood parental top-up and withholding are correct across the visa change? 2) I own a recurring hiring screen and a short-term contractor we hired for Q4; what's the quickest path to keep the contractor and transfer interview cadence while I'm out?

People Ops Bot: Start the formal leave request at https://hr.redwood.com/leave and attach supporting docs (birth/adoption cert, visa/passport pages, any local tax docs). For hiring/contractor ops, file a Hiring Ops ticket: hiring-ops@redwood.com. See cross-team checklist: https://hr.redwood.com/checklists/leave-handoff :memo:

Payroll: For the parental top-up to be applied on the first payroll during leave, upload all required docs at least 10 business days before Oct 2. Visa/status changes can affect tax withholding; if your residency or tax status changes, cc finance-relocation@redwood.com immediately so we can coordinate with payroll vendor.

Hiring Ops: For the contractor keep/extend flow, we need a manager-approved statement + headcount justification. If you want to keep the contractor with the same scope, please submit the Contractor Extension form and tag both People Ops and Hiring Ops. Expect ~7 business days for approvals if the packet is complete. For interview flow transfer, nominate a backup interviewer and we can set a temporary interview rotation.

Tom (Eng Lead): I can pick up the recurring screen and own the contractor approval paperwork with Priya's notes. Priya, please add the list of active candidates and suggested question set. I'll run a one-hour handoff session before you go.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks Tom 1 will compile candidate list and the contractor's task board. Quick Q: can the contractor be paid to a US or foreign entity during the visa transition?

Payroll: Contractors typically follow supplier jurisdiction rules. If the contractor is a US entity, payment can continue to US bank accounts. If they switch to a foreign entity, we need vendor paperwork and potentially a new SOW. Hiring Ops will coordinate vendor onboarding if needed.

IT Support: For equipment/shipping while you change visas, open a ticket at it-support@redwood.com. If you need a temporary loaner or remote access token, we can prepare that this week.

Priya (People Ops): Dropping a short handoff doc below and will upload to the leave form. Please skim and comment.

```
Handoff snapshot (Priya) - links will be in the ticket
- Leave dates: Oct 2 1 Dec 25 (12 weeks)
- Payroll docs needed: birth cert, visa/passport, proof of address if residency changes
- Payroll deadline: upload >=10 business days before Oct 2
- Contractor: Emily Contract (SOW v3) - recommended extension, keep billing same entity
- Interviews: weekly screens on Tue mornings -> Tom to own
- On-call: shift swap with Tom for Oct 9-15
- Emergency contact: priya-coverage@redwood.com
- Hiring Ops ticket: hiring-ops@redwood.com (attach extension form)
```

Hiring Ops: We'll start the contractor packet review once you submit the extension form. If you want to autopilot interviews, we can assign a temporary interview coordinator (we recommend reusing the same rubric).

Tom (Eng Lead): I'll block a handoff at 4pm Fri and review the interview rubric. Priya, can you add any candidate red-flags next to names?

Priya (People Ops): Will do. Thanks everyone 1 uploading docs and filing the Hiring Ops ticket now. Appreciate the quick turn-around on approvals so the contractor isn't disrupted.
